Package com.nexuslink.ui.files

Class FileOrder

java.lang.Object
com.nexuslink.ui.files.FileOrder
public final class FileOrder extends Object
The default ordering for a FileBrowserPane listing, matching what file commanders like WinSCP / Norton Commander show: the synthetic ".." row first, then directories before files, and within each group a case-insensitive name sort. Kept JavaFX-free so it is unit-testable.

  • Method Details

    • by

      public static Comparator<FileItem> by(FileOrder.SortKey key, boolean ascending)
      A commander-style comparator that keeps ".." first and directories before files, then orders by key in the requested direction. Only the key part reverses when ascending is false; the ".."/dirs-first grouping stays put. JavaFX-free, so it is unit-testable.
